runtime.title: Owner-managed Stripe plans, policies and production activation
notes: Adds an optional reusable managed billing module with encrypted per-installation Test and Live connection profiles, legacy settings adoption and owner-only configuration in the packaged admin.

Adds reviewed fixed-price creation and existing-price approval, dedicated customer portal policy application, invoice due-day defaults and clearly labelled owner reviews of Stripe account-wide retry, email and tax settings.

Adds server-checked readiness and explicit live activation behind the installation deployment gate. Connection, catalog and policy changes clear activation; signed webhook delivery and scheduler health are tracked in optional additive billing migrations.
Preserves scoped customers and client grants, idempotent financial operations and the source-configured billing factory. Setup creates no customers or charges, and upgrades do not activate billing.
